subject: [PATCH] mm/gup: unshare-check every page of a pte batch

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Identified inconsistencies in the changelog and questioned the effectiveness of the proposed fix. Suggested that the issue might be with the GUP user instead of the helper.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Clarified that the issue was caused by incorrect usage of the helper in the GUP slow path. Confirmed that a new version of the patch series will be sent soon.

2026-11-19.patch_summary: This patch addresses a bug in the gup (get user pages) helper, where it incorrectly assumes that all pages in a batch are writable or anonymous exclusive. The fix involves checking each page individually for suitability, ensuring that only writable batches and GUP-fast are unchanged.
